whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.subtitle: Direct Factory Sourcing & Agro-Engineering Partner
whoWeAre.description: Nairobi Machinery Hub (Nairobi) bridges Chinese manufacturer-direct agro-equipment with East African agricultural enterprises, commercial farms, SACCOs, and cooperatives. We handle factory verification, machinery customization, Mombasa CIF logistics, and field commissioning.

milestones.label: Verified Machinery Catalog Items
milestones.detail: Posho mills, grain dryers, oil expellers, potato washers, and 4WD tractors.

milestones.label: Direct Factory Transparency
milestones.detail: Clear CIF Mombasa pricing and direct WhatsApp communication.

milestones.label: Asset Financing Guidance
